strategies.name: Fused Mask-and-Scale Within Collectives

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree

Dispatch count depends on hierarchy depth but aims for ~10-12 collectives. Trades algorithmic complexity for bandwidth savings on multi-node interconnects.

strategies.name: Pipelined Block-Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Groups the 8 dependent all-reduces into micro-batches (e.g., 2 or 4 at a time) and overlaps communication of one batch with computation (masking/scaling) of the previous batch using asynchronous dispatch and explicit barrier placement. Maintains 8 logical stages but overlaps them, reducing wall-clock time at the cost of more complex orchestration.
